variants: Web-optimized visually high-quality lossy re-encodes at original 1920x1080 / 30fps; full durations and frame timings preserved. Original AAC audio packets copied without re-encoding. Not mathematically lossless.

health_applet.capture: Original HealthApplet Vue2/UniApp pages in an isolated HBuilderX H5 build with fictional fixtures. Original draggable hospital recommendation/detail components and selection events use a local simulated map adapter, not an online map service. 138 captured interaction frames include actual drag, map pan and release settling. Final package view exactly matches the existing booking captures in text and layout. Simulated ultrasound gallery/viewer and hospital-style report were added for this authorized demonstration.
health_applet.data: All institutions, experts, locations, personal records and ultrasound-style images are fictional demonstration data. Three AI-generated grayscale ultrasound rasters are not DICOM files. No production requests or real patient data.

quality_against_render_master.method: Video stream copy-remux; identical decoded frames and timing versus encoded H.264 render master. This is not a comparison against uncompressed source.

health_applet.verification: Independent review of all 1686 encoded frames via 17 contact sheets and 91 targeted frames, including 13 tap peaks, 3 drags, hospital selection/release settling, the package handoff and 247px continuous report scroll. Full-frame corruption scan and static holds show no suspects. Original/workbench composition parity: all 22 sampled frame pairs are pixel-identical using serial shared-browser ANGLE rendering. Homepage verified in 8 bilingual responsive layouts with actual 56.2-second 1080p playback, seeking, native no-JS fallback and no initial MP4 downloads. Local-only revision; not committed or deployed.
